checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas calculation safe from integer overflow?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Test with maximum possible base_length, modulus_length, exponent_length. 2. Calculate intermediate values (complexity * iterations). 3. Verify no overflow in 64-bit, 128-bit, or 256-bit arithmetic. 4. Check client source for appropriate integer types. 5. Test near-overflow values to trigger potential wrap-around.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0036, Trust Boundary: tb-006, STRIDE-EoP-tb-006

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are EIP-7825 and EIP-7883 activated simultaneously at Fusaka fork?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Check fork configuration for activation block/timestamp. 2. Verify EIP-7825 and EIP-7883 have identical activation. 3. Compare activation across all client implementations. 4. Test behavior at fork boundary (block N-1, N, N+1). 5. Any activation difference = consensus split risk.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0037, Trust Boundary: tb-007, STRIDE-Tampering-tb-007. Requires further investigation due to conditional scope.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do MEV-Boost relays validate gas cap for submitted blocks?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Submit block with oversized transaction to MEV-Boost relay. 2. Verify relay rejects the block. 3. Test with multiple relay implementations. 4. Verify proposer also rejects if relay somehow passes it. 5. Test end-to-end: malicious builder -> relay -> proposer.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0039, Trust Boundary: tb-008, STRIDE-Spoofing-tb-008
checklist_with_code.code_excerpt: // NOT FOUND: nimbus-eth2 has MEV-Boost code (beacon_chain/validators/message_router_mev.nim) but does not validate individual transaction gas caps in relay-submitted blocks. The unblinding process only verifies hash_tree_root equality of execution_payload_header vs payload.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does block validation catch private channel txpool bypasses?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Simulate Flashbots Protect-style private channel. 2. Submit oversized transaction through private channel. 3. Include in block and submit to validators. 4. Verify block validation catches violation. 5. Confirm no bypass path exists for private transactions.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0040, Trust Boundary: tb-008, STRIDE-Tampering-tb-008

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Pre-Condition: Is ceiling division used in multiplication_complexity for words?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Test max_length=33: words = ceil(33/8) = 5 (not floor = 4). 2. Test max_length=39: words = ceil(39/8) = 5. 3. Test max_length=40: words = ceil(40/8) = 5. 4. Test max_length=41: words = ceil(41/8) = 6. 5. Verify ceiling, not floor division throughout.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0042, Trust Boundary: tb-005, Pre-condition for q_large -> q_compute

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Post-Condition: Is iteration_count = bit_length(exponent) - 1 for small non-zero exponents?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Test exponent=1 (bit_length=1): iteration_count = 0, but max(0,1) = 1. 2. Test exponent=2 (bit_length=2): iteration_count = 1. 3. Test exponent=128 (bit_length=8): iteration_count = 7. 4. Test exponent=255 (bit_length=8): iteration_count = 7. 5. Verify bit_length computation is correct.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0043, Trust Boundary: tb-005, State: q_nonzero -> q_final (SG-002, EIP-7883)

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Post-Condition: Is bit_length of top 32 bytes computed correctly for large exponents?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Test exponent with leading zeros in top 32 bytes. 2. Verify bit_length only counts significant bits. 3. Test top_32_bytes = 0x00...01 (bit_length = 1). 4. Test top_32_bytes = 0x80...00 (bit_length = 256). 5. Verify correct extraction and bit counting.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0044, Trust Boundary: tb-005, State: q_large -> q_compute_large (SG-002, EIP-7883)

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Invariant: Is ModExp gas computation using only integer arithmetic (no floating-point)?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Audit client source code for ModExp gas calculation. 2. Verify no float/double types used. 3. Check all intermediate values are integer. 4. Verify floor() is on integer result, not float conversion. 5. Test on different hardware platforms for determinism.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0045, Trust Boundary: tb-006, Consensus-critical

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Pre-Condition: Is gas cap check on raw tx.gasLimit, not derived values?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Audit txpool code for gas cap check location. 2. Verify check is on raw field, not after any transformation. 3. Test with gasLimit values near 2^32 boundary. 4. Test with gasLimit values near 2^64 boundary. 5. Verify no truncation before comparison.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0047, Trust Boundary: tb-001, State: q_receive -> q_check (SG-001)

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Invariant: Is ModExp gas cost monotonically non-decreasing with input size?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. For base_length = 1 to 1000, verify gas(n) <= gas(n+1). 2. For modulus_length = 1 to 1000, verify monotonicity. 3. For exponent_length = 1 to 1000, verify monotonicity. 4. For exponent value increasing, verify monotonicity. 5. Any decrease indicates formula bug.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Trust Boundary: tb-005

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Invariant: Is EIP-7883 gas cost >= EIP-2565 gas cost for all inputs?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create comprehensive test vector of ModExp inputs. 2. Compute EIP-2565 gas for each input. 3. Compute EIP-7883 gas for each input. 4. Verify EIP-7883 >= EIP-2565 for all cases. 5. Any regression indicates implementation bug.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Trust Boundaries: tb-005, tb-006

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ECDSA signature recovery correctly deriving sender addresses?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Review recover_sender implementation for correct secp256k1_recover usage. 2. Verify keccak256 hash is correctly applied to recovered public key. 3. Test with malformed r/s/v values to ensure no sender address spoofing. 4. Attempt to craft a transaction that passes validation but returns wrong sender address. 5. Verify address derivation uses last 20 bytes of keccak256 hash.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0001. Boundary: tb-001, tb-009. Critical severity - signature forgery would enable complete account impersonation.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the ECDSA r-component range validation enforced?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Identify where r validation occurs in recover_sender. 2. Submit transaction with r == 0 and verify rejection. 3. Submit transaction with r == SECP256K1N and verify rejection. 4. Submit transaction with r == SECP256K1N - 1 and verify acceptance. 5. Check that rejection happens before any state access.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0002. Boundary: tb-001, tb-009. Pre-condition requiring 0 < r < SECP256K1N.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-2 low-s normalization enforced?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Submit transaction with s == 0 and verify rejection. 2. Submit transaction with s > SECP256K1N / 2 and verify rejection. 3. Submit transaction with s == SECP256K1N / 2 and verify acceptance. 4. Attempt transaction malleability by flipping s to SECP256K1N - s. 5. Verify both transaction variants cannot coexist in mempool.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0003. Boundary: tb-001, tb-009. High-s enables tx malleability per EIP-2.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are transaction type signing hashes non-colliding?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Enumerate all transaction types (legacy, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04). 2. Verify each type has unique prefix bytes. 3. Attempt to find field values that produce colliding signing hashes across types. 4. Verify type prefixes do not overlap with valid RLP first bytes for legacy. 5. Check that a signature from one type cannot be reused for another type.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0004. Boundary: tb-009. Cross-type signature confusion would change transaction semantics.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Conditional Scope: Pre-EIP-155 cross-chain replay vulnerability awareness
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Verify that v == 27 or v == 28 indicates pre-EIP-155 transaction. 2. Check if client defaults to pre-155 signing under any circumstances. 3. Verify warnings are displayed when handling pre-155 transactions. 4. Document any Fusaka-specific changes to pre-155 behavior. 5. Check that pre-155 transactions are still valid but flagged appropriately.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0005. CONDITIONAL SCOPE - Known design limitation. Only in-scope if Fusaka changes alter pre-155 behavior.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does snapshot mechanism provide true deep-copy isolation?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Review copy_trie implementation for deep vs shallow copy. 2. Create nested snapshots via contract calls. 3. Mutate state in inner call and verify outer snapshot remains unaffected. 4. Test rollback_transaction restores exact state from begin_transaction. 5. Check both _main_trie and _storage_tries are properly copied.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0006. Boundary: tb-003. Shallow copy would break transaction atomicity.

checklist_with_code.title: Is the snapshot count invariant maintained after begin_transaction?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Record len(state._snapshots) before begin_transaction. 2. Call begin_transaction and verify len(state._snapshots) increased by exactly 1. 3. Test nested begin_transaction calls maintain correct count. 4. Verify no snapshot count changes occur from concurrent operations. 5. Test edge cases with maximum nesting depth.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0007. Post-condition ensuring snapshot lifecycle integrity.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does commit_transaction correctly decrement snapshot count?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Record len(state._snapshots) before commit_transaction. 2. Call commit_transaction and verify len decreased by exactly 1. 3. Verify transient_storage._snapshots also decreases by 1. 4. Test complex call patterns that exercise commit under adversarial conditions. 5. Check for off-by-one errors in snapshot popping.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0008. Boundary: tb-003. Incorrect snapshot management could persist reverted state.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is created_accounts cleared only at outermost snapshot pop?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create nested transactions with account creation in inner call. 2. Commit inner transaction and verify created_accounts NOT cleared. 3. Commit outermost transaction and verify created_accounts IS cleared. 4. Test gas refund calculations depend on correct created_accounts state. 5. Verify EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT eligibility is correctly tracked.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0009. Boundary: tb-003. Affects EIP-2200 gas accounting and EIP-6780 constraints.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does rollback_transaction restore exact snapshot state?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Record complete state at begin_transaction. 2. Make multiple state modifications. 3. Trigger rollback_transaction via REVERT or out-of-gas. 4. Compare post-rollback state with recorded pre-modification state. 5. Verify both _main_trie and _storage_tries are identical to snapshot.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0010. Boundary: tb-003. Incomplete rollback breaks EVM atomicity guarantee.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transient storage correctly restored after rollback?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Set transient storage values before sub-call. 2. Modify transient storage in sub-call. 3. Trigger REVERT in sub-call. 4. Verify transient storage values match pre-sub-call state. 5. Test re-entrancy guard patterns using TSTORE-based locks.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0011. Boundary: tb-003. Transient storage desync could break re-entrancy guards (EIP-1153).

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are persistent and transient snapshot stacks synchronized?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Verify len(state._snapshots) == len(transient_storage._snapshots) at all times. 2. Test commit_transaction pops from both stacks atomically. 3. Test rollback_transaction pops from both stacks atomically. 4. Simulate exception during commit/rollback and verify no desync. 5. Check recovery behavior if stacks become desynchronized.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0012. Boundary: tb-003. Stack desync causes wrong rollback restoration.

checklist_with_code.title: Is get_account guaranteed to never return None?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Call get_account for nonexistent addresses and verify EMPTY_ACCOUNT returned. 2. Verify get_account never returns None under any input. 3. Test with addresses that have been destroyed. 4. Test with addresses at state trie boundaries. 5. Verify downstream functions handle EMPTY_ACCOUNT correctly.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0013. Invariant - None return would cause NoneType errors in state operations.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does set_account(None) preserve storage?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create account with storage. 2. Call set_account(addr, None). 3. Verify account removed from _main_trie. 4. Verify storage trie still exists in _storage_tries. 5. Document any code paths that call set_account(None) directly.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0014. Boundary: tb-005. Orphaned storage could be inherited by new accounts.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does destroy_account remove both account and storage atomically?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create account with storage. 2. Trigger SELFDESTRUCT (EIP-6780 constraints permitting). 3. Verify account removed from _main_trie. 4. Verify address NOT in _storage_tries. 5. Deploy new contract at same address and verify no storage inheritance.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0015. Boundary: tb-005. Incomplete destruction enables unauthorized storage access.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does destroy_storage handle double-deletion safely?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Call destroy_storage on address with storage - verify deletion succeeds. 2. Call destroy_storage on address without storage - verify no-op (no KeyError). 3. Call destroy_storage twice on same address - verify second is no-op. 4. Verify no exception propagates from double deletion. 5. Test under SELFDESTRUCT trigger conditions.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0016. Boundary: tb-005. KeyError during destruction would crash node.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does mark_account_created persist across reverts?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create account in sub-call via CREATE/CREATE2. 2. Revert the sub-call. 3. Verify address still in created_accounts. 4. Verify SSTORE gas accounting reflects created status. 5. Verify marker only cleared at outermost transaction commit.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0017. Boundary: tb-005. Affects EIP-2200 gas refunds and EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT eligibility.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does get_storage return U256(0) for unset keys?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Call get_storage on address without storage trie - verify U256(0). 2. Call get_storage on address with trie but unset key - verify U256(0). 3. Verify SLOAD opcode returns 0 for never-written slots. 4. Test at storage key boundaries (0x0, max uint256). 5. Test for destroyed accounts.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0018. Boundary: tb-005. Non-zero default would cause widespread contract execution errors.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does set_storage require account existence?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Attempt SSTORE to destroyed account within same transaction. 2. Verify AssertionError is raised before storage write. 3. Verify no orphaned storage trie is created. 4. Test via contract that SELFDESTRUCTs then tries SSTORE. 5. Verify state trie consistency after rejection.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0019. Boundary: tb-005. Orphaned storage tries would corrupt state.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are empty storage tries cleaned up?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Write storage value to new address. 2. Zero out the storage value. 3. Verify address NOT in _storage_tries after cleanup. 4. Write to same address again and verify new trie created. 5. Test memory growth from repeated write/zero patterns.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0020. Boundary: tb-005. Missing cleanup causes memory accumulation.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is storage_root blocked during active transaction?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Attempt storage_root computation with active snapshots. 2. Verify AssertionError is raised. 3. Verify assertion checks 'not state._snapshots'. 4. Test that block production code never calls storage_root mid-transaction. 5. Verify consensus code waits for transaction completion.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0021. Boundary: tb-010. Incorrect root during active tx causes consensus failure.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does state_root incorporate all storage roots?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Verify get_storage_root called for every account in _main_trie. 2. Verify correct root returned for accounts with storage. 3. Verify EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT returned for accounts without storage. 4. Compare computed state_root against reference implementation. 5. Test with large number of accounts with varying storage sizes.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0022. Boundary: tb-010. Missing/incorrect storage roots cause consensus split.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does account_has_storage check key existence only?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create account with storage trie containing entries. 2. Verify account_has_storage returns True. 3. Zero out all entries (empty trie). 4. Check if empty trie persists (depends on cleanup). 5. Verify return value matches key existence, not entry count.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0023. Boundary: tb-005. Known limitation - may return false positive for empty tries.

checklist_with_code.title: Is account liveness check correctly implemented?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Verify is_account_alive returns False for nonexistent address. 2. Verify is_account_alive returns False for EMPTY_ACCOUNT. 3. Verify is_account_alive returns True for any non-empty account. 4. Test EIP-161 empty account cleanup integration. 5. Verify liveness affects correct downstream operations.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0024. Incorrect liveness could prevent cleanup or destroy live accounts.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does modify_state destroy empty accounts?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create account with balance, transfer out all balance. 2. Verify account has nonce==0, code==b'', balance==0. 3. Verify destroy_account is called automatically. 4. Verify account removed from _main_trie. 5. Test all code paths through modify_state that could result in empty accounts.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0025. Boundary: tb-003, tb-005. State bloat and ghost accounts if cleanup fails.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ether conservation maintained in move_ether?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Record sender.balance + recipient.balance before move_ether. 2. Execute move_ether with various amounts. 3. Verify sum of balances unchanged after operation. 4. Test with maximum balance values to check overflow. 5. Verify atomic update of both balances.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0026. Boundary: tb-003, tb-005. Ether creation/destruction is catastrophic protocol violation.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does move_ether check sufficient balance?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Attempt move_ether with amount > sender.balance. 2. Verify AssertionError is raised. 3. Verify state is unchanged after rejection. 4. Test at balance boundaries (sender.balance == amount). 5. Verify no partial transfer occurs.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0027. Boundary: tb-003. Missing check enables unlimited ether extraction.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does increment_nonce increase by exactly 1?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Record nonce before increment_nonce. 2. Call increment_nonce and verify nonce == old_nonce + 1. 3. Test at U64.MAX - 1 boundary. 4. Verify wrapping behavior at U64.MAX (should not wrap). 5. Verify nonce is monotonically increasing.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0028. Boundary: tb-003. Nonce wrap-around enables replay of historical transactions.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does get_storage_original return U256(0) for created accounts?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create new account within transaction. 2. Call get_storage_original for any key. 3. Verify U256(0) returned regardless of current storage. 4. Verify SSTORE gas accounting reflects zero original value. 5. Test EIP-2200 gas refund calculations.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0029. Boundary: tb-005. Non-zero original for created accounts causes wrong gas refunds.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does get_storage_original read from outermost snapshot?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Record storage value before transaction. 2. Modify storage in transaction. 3. Call get_storage_original and verify it matches pre-tx value. 4. Verify _snapshots[0] is used, not current state. 5. Test in deeply nested call contexts.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0030. Boundary: tb-005. Wrong snapshot index causes incorrect EIP-2200 gas refunds.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does transient storage return U256(0) for unset keys?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Call get_transient_storage for address without transient trie. 2. Verify U256(0) returned. 3. Call for address with trie but unset key. 4. Verify U256(0) returned. 5. Test TLOAD opcode returns 0 for never-written slots.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0031. Boundary: tb-005. Non-zero default could break re-entrancy guards using EIP-1153.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transient storage properly scoped to single transaction?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Set transient storage in transaction A. 2. Commit transaction A. 3. Start new transaction B. 4. Read transient storage and verify all values are U256(0). 5. Verify transient_storage._tries is empty at transaction start.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0032. Boundary: tb-003, tb-005. Cross-tx leakage breaks all TSTORE/TLOAD contracts.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are empty transient storage tries cleaned up?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. TSTORE a value to new address. 2. TSTORE zero to same slot. 3. Verify address NOT in transient_storage._tries. 4. Test memory growth within single transaction. 5. Verify cleanup bounded by gas limit.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0033. Boundary: tb-005. Memory growth bounded by tx gas limit.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7623 gas validation enforced correctly?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Compute intrinsic_gas and calldata_floor for test transaction. 2. Submit tx with gas == max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor) - 1. 3. Verify InsufficientTransactionGasError raised. 4. Submit tx with gas == max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor). 5. Verify transaction accepted. Check for off-by-one in comparison.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0034. Boundary: tb-001, tb-002. Fusaka-specific EIP-7623 validation.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-2681 nonce overflow check enforced?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Submit transaction with nonce == U64.MAX_VALUE. 2. Verify NonceOverflowError raised. 3. Submit transaction with nonce == U64.MAX_VALUE - 1. 4. Verify transaction accepted (if other checks pass). 5. Verify U256 comparison used, not U64 (no wrap).
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0035. Boundary: tb-001, tb-002. Overflow to 0 enables historical tx replay.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE enforced for contract creation?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Submit contract creation tx with len(data) == MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE + 1. 2. Verify InitCodeTooLargeError raised. 3. Submit with len(data) == MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE. 4. Verify transaction accepted. 5. Verify check only applies when tx.to == Bytes0.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0036. Boundary: tb-001, tb-002. Oversized initcode causes DoS during deployment.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7825 TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT enforced?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Submit transaction with gas == 16,777,217 (TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT + 1). 2. Verify TransactionGasLimitExceededError raised. 3. Submit with gas == 16,777,216. 4. Verify transaction accepted. 5. Compare behavior across client implementations for consensus.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0037. Boundary: tb-001, tb-002. Fusaka-specific EIP-7825. Cross-client divergence causes consensus failure.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7623 calldata token counting correct?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Create calldata with known zero/non-zero byte distribution. 2. Compute expected tokens: zero_count*1 + non_zero_count*4. 3. Verify implementation matches expected token count. 4. Test edge cases: all zeros, all non-zeros, mixed patterns. 5. Verify both intrinsic_gas and calldata_floor use correct counts.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0038. Boundary: tb-001. Fusaka-specific EIP-7623 token counting.

checklist_with_code.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7623 calldata floor formula correct?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Compute expected calldata_floor manually: tokens * 10 + 21000. 2. Compare with implementation's calldata_floor. 3. Verify FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST == 10. 4. Verify TX_BASE_COST == 21000. 5. Test with various calldata sizes and compositions.
checklist_with_code.notes: Source: PROP-0039. Boundary: tb-001. Fusaka-specific EIP-7623 floor formula.
